observable_requirements.contract: In default/group scripts view, the treemap root node must not display a duplicated caption. Non-root nodes with rendered captions must split the caption into two distinct child span elements separating the resource/module name (styled with bold weight) and resource size (styled with dim secondary text).
The treemap canvas and resource table must preserve a side-by-side split layout on desktop viewports without table elements overflowing onto or obscuring the treemap container.

Nested nodes within the same bundle/script hierarchy must have depth-dependent background color variations (saturation and lightness shifting per nesting depth) rather than a single uniform flat color across all depths.

preserved_behaviors: Unused bytes visual coverage shading (percentage red pseudo-element) on leaf and bundle nodes must continue functioning accurately.
View mode switching (unused bytes vs. normal mode) and URL fragment data parsing must remain functional.
behavioral_contract.implementation_variation: Different color calculation functions (HSL/RGB math), class names, or DOM manipulation strategies (DOM APIs vs template strings) are permissible as long as the root caption is omitted in group view, child captions contain two distinct spans for name and size, and nested node background colors vary by depth.

test_bundles.coverage_gap_reason: Existing Puppeteer tests in treemap-test-pptr.js only verify debug loading, error handling, and coverage percentage shading width. They do not verify root caption removal, structured caption rendering (bold title + dim size spans), or nested depth color differentiation.
test_bundles.why_assertions_measure_requirements: The assertions directly query the rendered DOM in Puppeteer to verify that: (1) no `.webtreemap-caption` is present under `.webtreemap-node--root`, (2) non-root `.webtreemap-caption` elements contain two child spans for label and size, and (3) background colors between depth-1 and depth-2 nodes within the same bundle are distinct.
test_bundles.predicted_base_behavior: Fails because base code renders a caption in the root node, does not split caption text into child span elements, and assigns identical background colors across depths.
test_bundles.predicted_reference_behavior: Passes because root caption is deleted in group view, caption spans are created with bold and dim classes, and depth-based HSL saturation/lightness colors are assigned to nested nodes.

test_bundles.result_parser: Mocha standard test reporter; passing assertions exit code 0.
environment_assumptions: Headless Chrome / Puppeteer can launch locally using getChromePath().
StaticServer listens on port 20202 and serves the built treemap application.
yarn build-treemap is executed before running the Mocha suite.
test_bundles.equivalence_self_check: The test verifies the public rendered DOM and computed styles (root caption absence, span child count in captions, computed background color difference between parent and child nodes) rather than inspecting private methods like getColorFromHue or private maps.
vacuous_pass_checks: expect(captionInfo.totalCaptions).toBeGreaterThan(0) ensures the treemap actually rendered captions.
expect(colors).not.toBeNull() ensures parent and child node candidates were found and had non-transparent background colors.
test_bundles.surface_signal_resistance: A patch that simply adds dummy CSS classes without removing the root caption or without actually splitting text into span children will fail expect(captionInfo.hasRootCaption).toBe(false) or expect(captionInfo.spanCounts.every(count => count >= 2)).toBe(true).
